<MethodEndpoint
  method={"patch"}
  path={"/api/wiki/pages/{pageId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Any member who can see the page may edit it, unless it is `locked`
(then only its creator or an admin). Changing `locked` is reserved for
the creator or an admin. Send `baseUpdatedAt` (the `updatedAt` you
loaded) to detect concurrent edits: if someone saved in between, the
request is refused with `409` and the current page, and nothing is
overwritten. Omitting it saves unconditionally.
